passages.text: Chief complaint: headache for three weeks, worse with bending forward.
History: intermittent double vision over the past ten days. No recent head trauma.
Neurologic exam: cranial nerves II through XII assessed; mild weakness of left lateral gaze with horizontal diplopia. Strength, sensation, and gait normal.
Assessment: headache with intermittent diplopia (R51.9, H53.2). Neurologic red flag present.
Plan: order MRI brain (CPT 70553). Head CT from 2026-06-02 reviewed; see radiology report.
